_doc: Report editor evaluation set. Each case is a compact fact sheet (demo- or public-shaped) with the lead a good editor must choose, and recorded editor plans with the verdict each element must get from the checks. tests/evals/test_editor_evals.py runs them without a provider; scripts/ai/run_editor_eval.py sends the sheets to a provider and reports validity, kept elements, lead agreement and latency.
